_comment2: Select the DARK GAME AREA (right side) as your capture region, not the full browser window.
_comment3: Use --debug to save crops to /tmp/bj_debug/ and fine-tune the fractions below.

region._comment: Update x/y/width/height after running --select-region to match your screen.

detector._comment_templates: Capture templates from Stake cards with: python scripts/capture_templates.py --output assets/templates/stake
detector._comment_regions: Fractions [x, y, w, h] relative to captured region. These target the rank-pip corner of each card.

rules._comment: Stake Blackjack rules (verify in-game before relying on this)
